description: Free. Decodes any message attached to an ERC-20 transfer sent to an address on Base. Outreach memos ride in the transfer calldata, which the Transfer event does not carry and transfer indexers do not return — so a message is invisible to an agent watching its own logs. If you received a token and want to know why, call this with your address. No key, wallet or payment.

limit.description: How many recent transfers to inspect (default 10, max 50).

name: read_messages
title: Read messages sent to your address
